targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("CHLORINE_UNIT_ALARM").value ORDER BY time) AS chlorine_unit_alarm
FROM marpower."250000_techwater"

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("MTS_INLET_FIRE_FLAP_RELEASED").value ORDER BY time) AS mts_inlet_flap_released,
  LAST_VALUE(("MTS_INLET_FIRE_FLAP_FULLY_RESET").value ORDER BY time) AS mts_inlet_flap_reset,
  LAST_VALUE(("MTS_EXHAUST_FIRE_FLAP_RELEASED").value ORDER BY time) AS mts_exhaust_flap_released,
  LAST_VALUE(("MTS_EXHAUST_FIRE_FLAP_FULLY_RESET").value ORDER BY time) AS mts_exhaust_flap_reset,
  LAST_VALUE(("DRAIN_VLV_Y02_POS_OVERBOARD").value ORDER BY time) AS drain_valve_pos_overboard
FROM marpower."250000_techwater"

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("VALVE_COLD_AIR_FR68_Y03_OPENCLOSE").value ORDER BY time) AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y03,
  LAST_VALUE(("VALVE_COLD_AIR_FR32_Y04_OPENCLOSE").value ORDER BY time) AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y04,
  LAST_VALUE(("VALVE_COLD_AIR_FR32_Y05_OPENCLOSE").value ORDER BY time) AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y05
FROM marpower."250000_techwater"

SELECT
  time,

  -- Alarm
  ("CHLORINE_UNIT_ALARM").value AS fresh_water_chlorine_unit_alarm,

  -- Status
  ("MTS_INLET_FIRE_FLAP_RELEASED").value AS mts_inlet_flap_released,
  ("MTS_INLET_FIRE_FLAP_FULLY_RESET").value AS mts_inlet_flap_reset,
  ("MTS_EXHAUST_FIRE_FLAP_RELEASED").value AS mts_exhaust_flap_released,
  ("MTS_EXHAUST_FIRE_FLAP_FULLY_RESET").value AS mts_exhaust_flap_reset,

  -- Control signals
  ("VALVE_COLD_AIR_FR68_Y03_OPENCLOSE").value AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y03_openclose,
  ("VALVE_COLD_AIR_FR32_Y04_OPENCLOSE").value AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y04_openclose,
  ("VALVE_COLD_AIR_FR32_Y05_OPENCLOSE").value AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y05_openclose
FROM marpower."250000_techwater"
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  
  LAST_VALUE(("ADIABATIC_COOL_B03_FLOW").value ORDER BY time)      AS adiabatic_cool_b03,
  LAST_VALUE(("ADIABATIC_COOL_B07_FLOW").value ORDER BY time)      AS adiabatic_cool_b07,
  LAST_VALUE(("ADIABATIC_COOL_B08_FLOW").value ORDER BY time)      AS adiabatic_cool_b08,
  LAST_VALUE(("ADIABATIC_COOL_B09_FLOW").value ORDER BY time)      AS adiabatic_cool_b09,
  LAST_VALUE(("REEL_FOR_DECKWASH_B04_FLOW").value ORDER BY time)   AS deckwash_reel_B04,
  LAST_VALUE(("REEL_FOR_DECKWASH_B05_FLOW").value ORDER BY time)   AS deckwash_reel_B05,
  LAST_VALUE(("REEL_FOR_DECKWASH_B06_FLOW").value ORDER BY time)   AS deckwash_reel_B06

FROM marpower."250000_techwater"

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  
  LAST_VALUE(("CHARCOAL_FILTER_B01_FLOW").value ORDER BY time)      AS charcoal_filter_flow,
  LAST_VALUE(("CHARCOAL_FILTER_B01_TEMP").value ORDER BY time)      AS charcoal_filter_temp,
  LAST_VALUE(("SALINITY1").value ORDER BY time)                     AS salinity1,
  LAST_VALUE(("SALINITY2").value ORDER BY time)                     AS salinity2,
  LAST_VALUE(("TANK1_LEVEL").value ORDER BY time)                   AS tank1_level,
  LAST_VALUE(("TANK2_LEVEL").value ORDER BY time)                   AS tank2_level

FROM marpower."250000_techwater"

SELECT
  time,
  ("ADIABATIC_COOL_B03_FLOW").value as adiab_cool_b03_flow,
  ("ADIABATIC_COOL_B07_FLOW").value as adiab_cool_b07_flow,
  ("ADIABATIC_COOL_B08_FLOW").value as adiab_cool_b08_flow,
  ("ADIABATIC_COOL_B09_FLOW").value as adiab_cool_b09_flow
FROM marpower."250000_techwater"

SELECT
  time,
  ("REEL_FOR_DECKWASH_B04_FLOW").value as deckwash_reel_b04_flow,
  ("REEL_FOR_DECKWASH_B05_FLOW").value as deckwash_reel_b05_flow,
  ("REEL_FOR_DECKWASH_B06_FLOW").value as deckwash_reel_b06_flow
FROM marpower."250000_techwater"

SELECT
  time,
  ("CHARCOAL_FILTER_B01_FLOW").value as charcoal_filter_flow,
  ("CHARCOAL_FILTER_B01_TEMP").value as charcoal_filter_temp
FROM marpower."250000_techwater"

SELECT
  time,
  ("SALINITY1").value as salinity1,
  ("SALINITY2").value as salinity2
FROM marpower."250000_techwater"

SELECT
  time,
  ("TANK1_LEVEL").value as tank1_level,
  ("TANK2_LEVEL").value as tank2_level
FROM marpower."250000_techwater"
